calls.video_title: Market Volatility Is Back — Here’s How to Profit in 15 Minutes
calls.thesis: Guests (Brian, short-term): dark-ticker dip trade that has been working consistently — buy IWM calls in the 4:00-4:15pm ET window only if it closes down 1% or more that day, hold overnight / 1-2 days and sell on the next-day rebound. Small caps are hit harder by the first Fed rate-raising cycle in three years, so their volatility is rising. No price stated.
